warranty_and_returns.brand_warranty: All devices sold at NexPhone Studio are 100% genuine Indian retail units backed by official manufacturer brand warranties (1 Year for Phone, 6 Months for in-box accessories like charger & cable).
warranty_and_returns.replacement_policy: 7-Day Replacement Guarantee: If your phone exhibits any manufacturing hardware defect within 7 days of purchase, NexPhone Studio will provide an immediate brand-new replacement unit with no restocking fee.
warranty_and_returns.return_policy: Returns are accepted within 7 days in case of verified hardware defects or incorrect product delivery. The device must be in original physical condition with the original box, IMEI stickers, and all bundled accessories.
warranty_and_returns.service_centers: Complimentary assistance at any authorized service center nationwide. Customers can also bring devices to our store for free warranty claim handling.
